name: Perish
overview: The Bible teaches that perishing is a serious spiritual condition tied to rejection of God's knowledge and law, as Hosea 4:6 explains that lack of knowledge leads to destruction. Jesus emphasizes the eternal consequences of perishing, warning that God alone can destroy both soul and body in hell (Matthew 10:28). Yet, the gospel offers hope: God’s love is demonstrated in giving His Son so that believers should not perish but have everlasting life (John 3:16). This underscores the necessity of being born again to enter God’s kingdom and escape perishing (John 3:3).
